$comment: Machine-readable copy of the Evidence Map's MM12 vocabulary (source of truth = outcome-evidence-map.netlify.app → Skills & Evidence). ScribeIt tags workbooks against these IDs. canDo = the level-3 'independently demonstrates' statement; l4 = transfer descriptor. Keep in sync with the app.

mm12-skill-layers.title: Editable layers and masks
mm12-skill-layers.canDo: Selects the intended layer or mask, hides and restores an area, and reopens a layered master.
mm12-skill-layers.l4: Repairs a changed edge or overlap and explains why the chosen control works.
mm12-skill-layers.nextMove: Practise one conceal/restore repair on the correct thumbnail.

mm12-skill-hierarchy.title: Visual hierarchy and typography
mm12-skill-hierarchy.canDo: Makes the message, supporting information and action readable in the intended order.
mm12-skill-hierarchy.l4: Recomposes for a different format while preserving and defending the reading order.
mm12-skill-hierarchy.nextMove: Change one size, contrast or spacing variable and repeat the reader test.

mm12-skill-integration.title: Image integration and lighting
mm12-skill-integration.canDo: Uses consistent overlap, relative scale and light cues to place a subject in a scene.
mm12-skill-integration.l4: Adapts to a new source angle or light direction and explains the trade-off.
mm12-skill-integration.nextMove: Identify one conflicting light or depth cue before editing.

mm12-skill-capture.title: Original image capture
mm12-skill-capture.canDo: Produces a focused, intentionally exposed source image and explains its intended use.
mm12-skill-capture.l4: Adjusts capture decisions for a changed production brief and defends the selected source.
mm12-skill-capture.nextMove: Compare two exposures or light positions using a stable camera.

mm12-skill-meaning.title: Context and representation
mm12-skill-meaning.canDo: Uses visible features and source context to explain how an image represents an idea.
mm12-skill-meaning.l4: Compares two contextual readings and explains the limits of the evidence.
mm12-skill-meaning.nextMove: Separate what is visible from an inference about audience response.

mm12-skill-motion.title: Motion and timing
mm12-skill-motion.canDo: Uses timed movement and transitions to communicate an intended sequence.
mm12-skill-motion.l4: Adapts timing to a changed duration while retaining the communication goal.
mm12-skill-motion.nextMove: Compare two timings and predict how the emphasis changes.

mm12-skill-motion-workflow.title: Motion production workflow
mm12-skill-motion-workflow.canDo: Organises a timeline and assets and checks a rendered output against the brief.
mm12-skill-motion-workflow.l4: Diagnoses a changed frame size or duration requirement and delivers a working revision.
mm12-skill-motion-workflow.nextMove: Name sources, locate a missing asset and inspect the actual render.

mm12-skill-audio.title: Sound capture and editing
mm12-skill-audio.canDo: Creates an intelligible sound sequence with deliberate edits and usable levels.
mm12-skill-audio.l4: Repairs an unfamiliar noise or timing problem and explains the compromise.
mm12-skill-audio.nextMove: Record a short test, listen for the fault and change one cause.

mm12-skill-sound-meaning.title: Sound and image relationships
mm12-skill-sound-meaning.canDo: Explains how a sound choice changes the meaning of the same image sequence.
mm12-skill-sound-meaning.l4: Creates and defends an alternate sound treatment for a new audience or mood.
mm12-skill-sound-meaning.nextMove: Compare the same scene with two sound treatments.

mm12-skill-delivery.title: Production delivery and source log
mm12-skill-delivery.canDo: Delivers editable sources, a checked viewing copy and a usable asset/source log.
mm12-skill-delivery.l4: Solves a changed delivery requirement without losing the editable master or provenance.
mm12-skill-delivery.nextMove: Reopen the exported file and verify dimensions, links and source credits.

mm12-skill-collaboration.title: Individual contribution to a production
mm12-skill-collaboration.canDo: Identifies their own contribution and supplies a version or observed action that demonstrates it.
mm12-skill-collaboration.l4: Coordinates an unfamiliar dependency and shows how others can continue from the handoff.
mm12-skill-collaboration.nextMove: Allocate a small production responsibility and record the handoff.

mm12-skill-portfolio.title: Portfolio and next pathway
mm12-skill-portfolio.canDo: Selects contrasting work, explains growth and connects one skill to an actual pathway.
mm12-skill-portfolio.l4: Recurates for a different audience and supports a realistic next training or career decision.
mm12-skill-portfolio.nextMove: Choose a before/after pair and name the next action.

all-skill-turns.title: Balanced participation
all-skill-turns.canDo: Takes an agreed turn and makes space for another contribution.
all-skill-turns.note: Shared habit — keep separate from achievement unless a course criterion explicitly assesses it.

all-skill-coach.title: Coach without taking over
all-skill-coach.canDo: Asks a useful question while the partner controls their own work.
all-skill-coach.note: Shared habit — keep separate from achievement.

all-skill-feedback.title: Use feedback and revise
all-skill-feedback.canDo: Identifies feedback, makes a relevant change and explains its effect.
all-skill-feedback.note: Shared habit — keep separate from achievement.

all-skill-goal.title: Plan a small next step
all-skill-goal.canDo: Names a feasible next action and the evidence that will show it happened.
all-skill-goal.note: Shared habit — keep separate from achievement.
